anchor_quotes: 3: How many are working on this plot against the city? Everyone operates in small groups so the number is not known, but Lira will finish the plot before she dies.

beats.title: The Shepherd and the Plan
beats.summary: Wolf says the Shepherd is everywhere, in all minds; the plan cannot be stopped, they will erupt led by the Shepherd, all will die and be consumed, and the Shepherd rises from below at dawn.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:56-56
anchor_quotes: 4: Where is the Shepherd? Everywhere! In all the minds of the people.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:58-58
anchor_quotes: Fifth question asked by the Necromancer: What is the plan and how will we know when it is complete? There is no stopping it! They are gathering now and will soon erupt as something new, led by the Shepherd. All will die and be consumed. You will know at the break of dawn as the Shepherd rises from below.

beats.title: Ambush and Draven's Monologue
beats.summary: After the ritual, Draven locks the door; Elite Guards and a Sewer Meat Monster enter. Draven monologues and casts Fear on Bonogo, but Stafl helps deflect it.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:60-60
anchor_quotes: After the ritual Professor Cinderbranch leaves the room, just as Draven closes and locks the door. Suddenly one of the walls opens up and 2 Elite Guards enter with a large and disgusting Sewer Meat Monster.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:62-62
anchor_quotes: Draven begins to monologue about cooking and eating Stafl and Bonogo as he casts Fear on Bonogo.

beats.title: Combat in the Morgue
beats.summary: Stafl counterattacks and puts Draven to sleep; Bonogo kills the sleeping necromancer. Remaining enemies attack; Bonogo and Stafl take damage and poison.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:62-62
anchor_quotes: Stafl counters with a radiant burst and casts Sleep on Draven, who falls asleep. Bonogo sneak attacks the sleeping necromancer and deals massive damage resulting in a killing blow.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:64-64
anchor_quotes: With his bonus attack Bonogo then strikes out at Elite Guard 2, but misses. That guard then attacks and hits Bonogo, poisoning him as well. Just as he is being poisoned, the Sewer Monster bites Bonogo, dealing more damage.

beats.title: Escape and Killing the Guard
beats.summary: Stafl runs for the door, yells for help, and casts Sleep on remaining enemies; Bonogo also runs but attacks the sleeping guard, killing him.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:66-66
anchor_quotes: As soon as he is outside the door he yells for help then casts Sleep on the remaining enemies. Bonogo also runs for the door, but takes the opportunity to attack the sleeping guard, dealing massive damage and racking up another kill.

beats.title: Empty Ritual Room and Descent
beats.summary: The group finds the ritual room empty; with Mages' help they stock up on items before heading down the tunnel.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-13:55b65ec5dcec:span:55b65ec5dcec:68-68
anchor_quotes: After explaining to Cinderbranch what happened, the group finds the ritual room empty, a bad sign of what is to come. With the help of the Mages the party can stock up on items before they head down the tunnel to see what awaits…
